response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copies FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating) SELECT film_id, rating, copies, copies - AVG(copies) OVER (PARTITION BY rating) AS diff_from_rating_avg, copies - AVG(copies) OVER () AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM c ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Copies are counted as rows in inventory per film across both stores combined; films with no inventory rows are excluded via the inner join, so they are left out of all averages.
The rating average and overall average are taken over the per-film copy counts (one value per film), as the request states.
